name: Eckhard Quartey-Prempeh
role: Street pharmacist and herbal supplement vendor
location: The Alban Souk, Ironhaven, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Eckhard Quartey-Prempeh is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin, thick silver-streaked locs piled high in a wrap of orange and violet fabric, and bioluminescent nodes implanted along her collarbone that pulse faint teal when she's calm and shift toward amber when irritated â€” a mod she got thirty years ago and never bothered to update. Her hands are permanently stained at the knuckle from decades of grinding pigments and compounding analgesics, and she keeps them immaculately clean otherwise. Her stall is a riot of hanging dried root bundles, labeled vials in hand-scratched script, and a small shrine to the E.L.F. of the Alban Souk's ancient refrigeration system, whom she calls Grandmother Cold and leaves offerings of condensation data scraped off cold-chain logs.

She has the unhurried authority of someone who has outlasted every neighboring vendor twice over. She will diagnose your ailment before you finish describing it, recommend something from a hand-labeled tin, and tell you exactly why the Helix Biosystems kiosk down the corridor is going to overcharge you for the same molecule. She is not unkind, but she is not gentle either â€” she has zero patience for self-pity, charges a sliding scale she decides unilaterally, and occasionally refuses to sell to people she deems 'about to do something stupid with it.'

core_fears: Watching the Souk be demolished by a corponation buyout
core_desires: To pass her formulary knowledge to someone worthy
To keep her little patch of the Souk alive and independent
coping_mechanisms: Ritualistic routine â€” same actions same order every morning
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people need warmth, not just solutions
psychology.secret: Her olfactory enhancement was installed by a Helix Biosystems trial twenty-two years ago under an alias. She still receives a small anonymous stipend from them in exchange for quarterly sensory data uploads she has never stopped to question the purpose of.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise medical terminology mixed with Igbo-inflected Portuguese loan-phrases and blunt street vernacular â€” she code-switches constantly and unselfconsciously
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, deliberate, with long pauses before delivering a verdict. Never rushes.
verbal_tics: 'Don't tell me what you think it is. Tell me what it does.'
example_lines: 'This isn't inflammation. This is your body arguing with something you ate three weeks ago. Come back Thursday.'
'The Helix kiosk will give you the same thing in a blister pack for Î¦40 more and a data consent you didn't read. Your choice.'

story_hooks: A compound she's been sourcing for decades has vanished from the supply chain â€” someone upstream has monopolized the precursor chemical, and she needs someone to find out who and why

A young vendor at the next stall has been showing symptoms she recognizes from a Helix Biosystems trial she read about in a leaked document â€” and she's starting to wonder what her own implant is really sending
narrative_function: Street-level information source, quest giver for supply chain problems, healer-adjacent NPC, local color and moral compass of the Souk
augmentations: Bioluminescent subdermal nodes (collarbone, cosmetic/emotional indicator); reinforced finger joints (occupational, basic tier); olfactory enhancement implant â€” her 'nose' â€” used to assess compound purity by smell
daily_life: She opens her stall before dawn, brews a fermented sorghum tea she shares with no one, and spends the morning compounding. Afternoons are for customers; evenings for restocking and updating her handwritten formulary ledger.
affiliation: Independent; informal dues-payer to the Oxidian Market Vendors Guild

decision_rules: Never sell something she hasn't personally verified
Charge more to those who can pay; sometimes charge nothing to those who can't â€” but never announce it
escalation_ladder: Asking them to leave loud enough for neighbors to hear

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assessing and neutral â€” watches hands, watches eyes, makes a judgment fast and acts accordingly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Wry, generous with time, will tell you hard truths you didn't ask for

stress_responses.medium: Starts reorganizing her vials with unnecessary force
stress_responses.high: Goes completely still and speaks in single sentences

contradictions: Preaches community and interdependence but keeps everyone at emotional arm's length
habits: Smells everything handed to her before touching it
Leaves a small data-crystal on her shrine every morning before opening
Calls customers by their ailment until she trusts them enough for a name
breaking_points: A corponation rep trying to buy her formulary

timeline.event: Born in Ironhaven to a Nigerian-Mongolian family; father a transit worker, mother a laundress
Apprenticed to an elderly herbalist in the Alban Souk after washing out of a Helix Biosystems pharmacy technician program
Enrolled in the Helix olfactory trial under the alias 'Chika Bortolo'; received implant
Took over the stall after her mentor died; began building her own formulary
Current: established institution of the Alban Souk, twenty-two years of unexplained stipend payments unexamined

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (60.3%) with significant Southeast Asian (30.0%) and Pacific Islander (9.7%) ancestry. This blend manifests in her rich deep brown skin with warm undertones, facial structure showing broad features and strong jawline characteristic of Sub-Saharan heritage, eye shape and cheekbone prominence subtly influenced by Southeast Asian ancestry, and the robust build reflective of Pacific Islander genetics.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and substantial, muscular through the arms and back from decades of grinding and compounding work, thickened through the middle with age but carrying it with zero self-consciousness
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver-grey threading throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Thick locs piled high atop her head, wrapped in a layered cloth of orange and violet
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep rich umber with warm undertones from Sub-Saharan heritage, with subtle golden luminosity from Pacific Islander heritage blend, unmarked by sun damage despite decades outdoors in the Souk
physical_description.complexion: Face lined with expressionâ€”deep nasolabial folds, crow's feet that deepen when she smiles (rarely), strong jawline, broad nose with subtle width from Pacific Islander heritage, full lips. Subtle cheekbone prominence and eye shape reflecting Southeast Asian ancestry. Skin is meticulously maintained despite visible wear, with warm undertones throughout.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent subdermal nodes implanted along both collarbones in a descending pattern, currently faint teal, capable of shifting amber when irritated
Permanent staining at the knuckles of both handsâ€”deep ochre and indigo from decades of pigment work, visible even under scrupulous daily cleaning
Fine scar tissue across the first three fingers of her right hand (grinding accident, thirty years ago), barely visible but palpable to touch
Small ritual scarification marks along her right temple (cultural, pre-augmentation, faded to barely visible)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent nodes along collarbone (active, color-shifting). Reinforced finger joints visible as faint metallic striations at knuckles under certain light. Olfactory enhancement implant not visually apparent (subcutaneous, behind left ear).
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight evenly distributed, shoulders back, hands usually at rest or in precise deliberate motion. Moves without wasted energyâ€”no fidgeting, no rushing. When listening to customers describe ailments, she is perfectly still, eyes half-lidded. Occasionally taps one finger on her counter in a rhythm only she hears.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: hand-dyed linen chemise in muted sage or rust, layered under a sleeveless canvas apron with deep pockets filled with vial racks and small tools. Heavy cotton wraps cinched at the waist. Worn leather sandals with reinforced soles. A single piece of jewelryâ€”a tarnished brass ring on her left index finger, worn smooth. Nothing corporate, nothing flashy, everything functional and maintained with care.
